messages.body:
Hi Priya,

1. Android 14, app 3.3.0
2. Receive the "new manifest" push
3. Tap the notification instead of opening the app first
4. Crash (stack trace attached in the ticket, ~80% repro rate on two test devices)

messages.subject: Beacon Desk demo — Thursday
messages.body:
Ingrid,

Proposal for the Beacon Desk demo:

- Thursday 14:00-15:00, big meeting room
- Attendees: me, Aisha, one support person of her choosing
- Vendor joins remotely, I'll handle the screen sharing

One open item: lunch. My take: wrap platter, not pizza — pizza at a vendor demo means grease on the shared laptop. I'll order the wraps for Thursday myself, vegetarian half. Consider it done.

If the 14:00 slot clashes with anything of yours, tell me by Wednesday noon, otherwise it stands.

Cheers, Dev
